name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A.
tagline: A leading global financial services group with strong capital management and shareholder returns.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le ratio de capital total de BBVA est un indicateur clé de sa solidité financière et de sa capacité à absorber les pertes, ce qui est crucial dans le secteur bancaire. Il reflète la gestion prudente des risques et la conformité réglementaire.

kpis.explanation: Mesure la solidité financière d'une banque en comparant ses fonds propres aux actifs pondérés par les risques.
kpis.signal: Solid capital ratio exceeding regulatory requirements.
kpis.description: Indicates BBVA's capacity to absorb potential losses, with estimated excess capital reserves of 15.0 billion as of December 31, 2025, surpassing the minimum regulatory requirement of 13.44%.
kpis._validation: Signal translated to English; description improved for clarity and consistency with source

kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid to shareholders for the 2024 fiscal year.
kpis.signal: Final dividend increase demonstrates confidence in performance.
kpis.description: Final dividend approved for 2024 totaled 2,357 million euros, payable on April 10, 2025, representing 0.41 per share gross (0.3321 net of withholding tax).
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds €' to 'M €' (millions, not billions); YoY recalculated: (2357-2245)/2245 = +5.0%; signal translated to English; explanation translated to English

kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid during the fiscal year for 2025 results.
kpis.signal: Interim dividend growth reflects strong 2025 earnings distribution.
kpis.description: Interim dividend of 1,840 million euros approved and paid on November 7, 2025, representing 0.32 per share gross (0.2592 net of withholding tax) for 2025 results.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds €' to 'M €'; YoY recalculated: (1840-1668)/1668 = +10.3%; signal and explanation translated to English

kpis.explanation: Maximum amount allocated for share repurchase program in 2025.
kpis.signal: Substantial increase in share buyback capacity signals strong capital position and shareholder returns policy.
kpis.description: Framework buyback program announced December 18, 2025, with maximum monetary amount of 3,960 million euros for share capital reduction. First tranche of 1,500 million initiated December 22, 2025, with 51.2 million shares acquired by February 13, 2026.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds €' to 'M €'; YoY recalculated: (3960-993)/993 = +299.1% (approximation of +399% noted as framework program); signal translated to English; description expanded with execution details from source

kpis.explanation: Maximum amount allocated for share repurchase program in 2024.
kpis.signal: Share buyback program increase reflects continued capital returns to shareholders.
kpis.description: Buyback program of 781 million euros announced January 30, 2024, and executed between March 4 and April 9, 2024. Total of 74,654,915 shares acquired, representing 1.28% of share capital.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds €' to 'M €'; YoY recalculated: (781-422)/422 = +85.1%; signal translated to English; description expanded with execution details from source

kpis.explanation: Maximum amount allocated for share repurchase program in 2023.
kpis.signal: Initial share buyback program demonstrates commitment to capital management.
kpis.description: Share buyback program of 422 million euros authorized March 17, 2023, executed internally between March 20 and April 20, 2023. Total of 64,643,559 shares acquired, representing 1.07% of share capital.
kpis._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds €' to 'M €'; signal translated to English; description corrected (2023 program relates to 2022 results, not 2022 program); execution details added from source
